mapper.sql: mr.id, mr.member_id, m.login_id AS author_login_id, mr.music_id, mr.preference_score, mr.running_fit_score, mr.review_content, mr.created_at, mr.updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO music_reviews ( member_id, music_id, preference_score, running_fit_score, review_content ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{musicId}, #{preferenceScore}, #{runningFitScore}, #{reviewContent} )
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM music_reviews mr LEFT JOIN members m ON m.id = mr.member_id WHERE mr.id = #{id}

SELECT
FROM music_reviews mr LEFT JOIN members m ON m.id = mr.member_id WHERE mr.music_id = #{musicId} ORDER BY mr.created_at DESC, mr.id DESC

SELECT #{musicId} AS music_id, AVG(preference_score) AS average_preference_score, AVG(running_fit_score) AS average_running_fit_score, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM music_reviews WHERE music_id = #{musicId}
